## Description (from the registry)

Expert on Octopus Review (octopus-review.ai) — the open-source (MIT), RAG-based, codebase-aware AI PR reviewer wired into this org. Manages usage limits (BYOK vs self-host vs OSI-public free tier), keeps the Qdrant vector index fresh, operates @octp/cli, keeps Octopus-filed issues routing into the WR pipeline, and owns model routing including OpenRouter via the self-host OpenAI-compatible gateway slots.
